### Answers for Each Day: Obedience
Author: Bayless Conley
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/answers/answers-for-each-day-oct-23-11583294.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:22
Points:
- King Saul excused his failure to destroy the Amalekites' livestock by claiming they were kept for sacrifice.
- Samuel made clear that the Lord values listening to His voice over religious lip service and animal sacrifices.
- Sacrifices can never restore what is lost through willful disobedience.
- Obedience serves a preventative purpose by guarding God's people from falling into sin.
- God's primary desire for His people is straightforward obedience to His commands.

### The Good and the Better
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-good-and-the-better
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:17-23
Points:
- Samuel confronts Saul by reminding him that God elevated him to the throne from humble beginnings.
- Saul contradicted himself and shifted blame to the people when caught preserving the Amalekite plunder.
- God takes greater delight in heartfelt submission and listening to His voice than in ritual observances.
- God views rebellion and stubbornness as equivalent to the sins of idolatry and witchcraft.
- Outward spiritual habits must never become a substitute for total obedience to God's authority.

### Truth For Life: Resist Deceit
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-oct-18-2010-11639620.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:22
Points:
- Saul used the pretense of religious sacrifice as an excuse for outright rebellion against God.
- Outward religious ceremonies and zealous pretenses can never replace keeping Christ's actual commands.
- God's people must beware of the self-deceit of honoring religious forms while neglecting His Word.
- True devotion requires listening to God and carrying out His instructions in both large and small matters.

### Why Does Samuel Say Obedience Is Better Than Sacrifice?
Author: Jessica Udall
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/why-does-samuel-say-obedience-is-better-than-sacrifice.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:22
Points:
- Saul rationalized his partial compliance by blaming his soldiers and claiming the spared animals were for offerings.
- God's concern is the obedience of the heart rather than external, empty ritual practices.
- The sacrificial system was never an end in itself, pointing forward instead to the perfect sacrifice of Christ.
- Human effort alone cannot produce genuine obedience without the transforming work of the Holy Spirit.
- Believers are called to present their entire lives as living sacrifices rooted in love and faithfulness.
